svg.title: Scoped support, roles and regimes — p360-status-r2
svg.desc: Derived from r1 independently accepted with material advisories under impl55. This FIG009 p360-status-r2 revision's acceptance is resolved by an external audit record matching the file SHA-256. This SVG grants no publication, source-inclusion or deployment authority. Resolve each current authorization and execution state and the public locator in trusted external records keyed by FIG009, p360-status-r2, language and file SHA-256. Infer no authority if records are missing, mismatched or conflicting. An analytical candidate. A primary support carries LR and LE role vocabulary and the same-support LE-prime regime annotation. Read header, graph and local key, statuses and provenance, then equal scopes and ownness. Unknown is not a negative classification. No formation, convergence, autonomy or empirical certification. Legacy retained separately.
